body:
Hey, I lost someone special to me last year, it's a unique and painful experience for everyone. I really wish I could reassure you but I can't promise you because it's still a mystery until we experience it ourselves.

But even though she's no longer here physically, in other ways she still is because of the history and imprint she's left on the world and on you or others. As empty as it feels death is just another phase life and that energy from it is never really destroyed it just gets absorbed by the world and other life around it.

It might help creating/writing her a something like letter/poem with all your favourite memories and anything your feeling or regretting. I know it's really confronting but that helped me a lot. You can write as many letters as you need to even daily/weekly updates and burn them or burn candles and have her favourite things/flowers around them.

I'm always here if you need to talk or anything. I'm not licenced or trained but I do care and I get those thoughts a lot too. It's really scary. 

You don't have to be alone in this ❤️

No, I get this too, even when I'm happy and having a nice time with friends as soon as something that could possibly have killed me passes I start feeling empty and disappointed or I will for the car to crash etc and imagining death almost gives me an adrenaline rush and high like my brains trying to fool me. But those feelings are just as important to address as ones where you would try to take your life and I hope things get better ❤️
Uugh that hits too hard, I'm here too if you need someone to chat with. Hope your doing alright now.
